name: jevmate
description: A fast decision layer for coding agents: Jev ranks files, picks tests, sorts failures, reviews diffs and keeps what the work needs through a compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Cheap, calibrated decisions before the expensive model reads anything.
interface.longDescription: jev is a command that answers yes/no, pick-one and rubric questions with a calibrated probability in about 250 ms. jevmate puts it in front of Codex: which files to read, which tests a change can break, which failures share a cause, which hunks are risky. Hooks trim long output, sort red test runs, screen fetched content, flag destructive commands, and judge the tool results before a compaction so the ones the work still needs come back verbatim.
defaultPrompt: Which files under src/ should I read first to find where retries happen?
Run the tests this change can break first.
Group these test failures by cause.
